description: Drones attacked a refinery in Saratov. There are also reports of a fire at the Ozon logistics hub. Around 02:00, the governor of the Saratov region, Roman Busargin, announced the threat of an attack by anti-aircraft missiles in the region. At the moment, the consequences of the attack there are unknown. In addition, explosions were heard in Engels, Saratov Region.

Кроме того, взрывы раздавались в Энгельсе Саратовской области.
